messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Begin with "Expense review begins", then "Read expense claim", then the decision "Receipt attached?". Its Yes branch goes to "Approve reimbursement"; its No branch goes to "Reject reimbursement". Both alternative stages lead directly to "Record decision", which leads to "Expense review complete".

response.text: Expense review begins with Read expense claim being connected with Receipt claim which if Receipt claim is No then Reject reimbursement which if Receipt claim is Yes then Approve reimbursement which if Receipt claim is Yes then Record decision which if Record decision is Expense review complete then Expense review complete. Also, Receive reimbursement is connected with Record decision which if Record decision is Expense review complete then Expense review complete.
